Patient and Staff Experience

Patient experience - Friends and Family scores

Royal Liverpool (REMRQ)

Clatterbridge (REN)

Papworth (RGM)

    ------------- Inputs -------------
    Market ID: site_code
    Date Variable: month
    Matching Metric: friends_and_family_percent

    Test Market: RGM22
    Control Market 1: RA701
    Control Market 2: RHQNG
    Control Market 3: RJE01
    Control Market 4: RX1CC
    Control Market 5: RYJ03

    Matching (pre) Period Start Date: 2013-04-01
    Matching (pre) Period End Date: 2019-05-01
    Post Period Start Date: 2019-06-01
    Post Period End Date: 2021-05-01

    bsts parameters: 
      prior.level.sd: 0.05
      No seasonality component (controlled for by the matched markets) 
    Posterior Intervals Tail Area: 95%

    ------------- Model Stats -------------
    Matching (pre) Period MAPE: 1.07%
    Beta 1 [RA701]: 0.0301
    Beta 2 [RHQNG]: 0.0466
    Beta 3 [RJE01]: -0.0727
    Beta 4 [RX1CC]: 0.1199
    Beta 5 [RYJ03]: 0.1371
    DW: 1.41

    ------------- Effect Analysis -------------
    Absolute Effect: 17.35 [0.13, 34.06]
    Relative Effect: 1.2% [0.01%, 2.37%]
    Probability of a causal impact: 97.5952%
